The '''Goibniu system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Videnda sector/Legends|Videnda sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Goibniu Platform]] was [[Battle of Goibniu|attacked]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="XWvTF" />
